historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved, with conditions, a trailer as a temporary sales office on the site until construction began on a planned 12-storey, 48-unit condominium apartment house.
The 6,393.75-square-foot lot, 47.5 feet on Broadway, between the Panorama condominium tower and the Sarah Dix Hamlin School, was vacant and unpaved and sometimes used as an unauthorised parking lot.

The City Planning Commission unanimously approved a four-storey, four-unit apartment house of buff masonry with an eight- or nine-space garage on the vacant lot, subject to meeting the rear-yard rules (Resolutions 7855 and 7856).
The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works and granted the permit to alter the building at 2190 Broadway.
